# Git Commit Message Instructions

Generate concise, professional git commit messages in English.

## Rules
- Use Imperative mood (e.g., "Add feature" not "Added feature").
- Keep the summary line under 50 characters.
- Do not period (.) at the end of the summary line.
- Focus on "what" and "why", not "how".
- Avoid fluff words like "update", "fix", or "refactor" without context.
- Separate subject from body with a blank line if body is needed.
